snippet.title: Speed Farmers alpha v0.1 gameplay
snippet.description:
This is an early gameplay video for Speed Farmers.
Speed Farmers is a game where you need to farm as fast as you can. You hire a plot of land, but the taxes keep getting higher. Survive as long as you can!

Download game: https://jxlle.itch.io/speed-farmers
Twitter: https://twitter.com/JAT_Games
Other twitter: https://twitter.com/JelleVandesijpe
